description:
Hushfeed v0.15.1 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`).

The repository is public from this release, so Morphe Manager can add it as a source from the project page: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc/hushfeed

Build tooling refreshed: Gradle 9.7.1, guava 33.7.1 and androidx annotation 1.10.0. The Android Gradle plugin and Kotlin come from the Morphe patches plugin (AGP 9.1.0, Kotlin 2.4.10), and the patcher stays at 1.12.0 to match the stable manager.

The bundle is otherwise the same as v0.15.0: the first release under the project's own name, with the block button fix, the author region, content warning skip, the caption, music line, action column, survey and status bar hides, long-press controls, and a settings screen that follows the phone's language (English and German).

Install: add the source in Morphe Manager, or download `patches-0.15.1.mpp` and load it as a local bundle. Patch TikTok 46.2.3 and keep the manager's signing key.

Validation: 149 runtime tests passed, the bundle holds 61 patches and passed the checks for all three DEX payloads.
